description: This file contains React components and functions for rendering Markdown content with support for mathematical notation, syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, and other rich content features in a React application.

classes.name: Mermaid
classes.description: React component for rendering Mermaid diagrams and viewing them in a new window.

classes.description: React component for rendering code blocks with support for Mermaid diagrams.
